text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Epiglottic entrapment is a type of<n>illness that affects
an Umamusume's<n>respiratory tract. Due to the
abnormal<n>folds in my throat, I have difficulty
breathing when running longer<n>distances...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'll just have to take the<n>2,000-meter
Shuka Sho off my<n>schedule. Good luck out there,
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I get surgery, I'll have to take a<n>hiatus of at least
six months... So I'd<n>rather not get it if I can help it. If
I stop<n>running for that long, people will give<n>up on
their dreams, and I'll be too late<n>to help them!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's time to change directions! My<n>next goal is the
1,600-meter Mile<n>Championship!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A few days after deciding that, I get a<n>message
from Taiki saying she's<n>going to be running in the
Mile<n>Championship too! This won't be an<n>easy
one...
